# Two scheduled public raw-artifact pilot waves

Historical Goal 39 prototype. Its builder depends on ignored checkpoint 41
admissions, artifact reviews and exact old source-generation receipts. These
files preserve that experiment; the commands below require those historical
inputs and are not fresh-checkout reproduction instructions. Use
[the maintained lifecycle fixture](compartment_lifecycle_runtime.md) for current
lifecycle qualification. Source-writing and authorization statements below
describe the original milestone.

The three new files implement the admitted source-only milestone B from
`goals/progress/39/contract-41-raw-parent-pilot.md` (SHA256
`ca3c7a33447b18c7eb1fe5bbbf63e035ef38de0a74f4a602ecceb0f322f1ae64`).
The root admission is `checkpoint41-raw-parent-pilot-root-admission01.json`
(SHA256 `6aaf7c598a08c3f7841c76870889bf349ed51ef8aac30ee4796f307a9bd01542`).
No parent compilation, packaging, VM, pilot or whole-goal qualification was
performed while writing these sources. The existing kernel, libc,617 protected
sources, five raw-artifact sources and old fixtures remain unchanged.

The parent uses actual public CREATE to run one static and then one genuine tiny
interpreter workload. Each raw child proves its initial FD9 grant, immutable
startup/credential/limit observations,16 private File/SysV rounds and fresh later
work, then remains live until its known Host parent sends SIGKILL9. The parent
closes the grant before kill, consumes only that exact positive PID and requires
raw wait status9. A separate original-init service exit witness observes the
parent's actual exit0. These are uninjected WARMUP/PILOT waves; they do not count
towards1,000 successful lifecycles or24 actually-consumed fault stages.

## Files and future build

- `lifecycle_raw_pilot.cpp`: one hosted, single-threaded parent and optional
  read-only init exit witness. Post-start operations use signed raw WOS calls,
  fixed buffers, no signal handler, fork, thread, malloc or errno retry loop.
- `build_lifecycle_raw_pilot.py`: future exclusive artifact builder. It requires
  the actual three-ELF PASS_ARTIFACT_ONLY receipt and independent current source/
  generated-disassembly review before writing output. It validates immutable
  source/tool/include/artifact pins and emits `lifecycle_raw_pilot_expectations.hpp`
  with all44,584 actual ELF bytes, SHA identities and exact entry/PHNUM constants.
  The parent compares the same asset FD's full bytes and EOF before/after CREATE;
  no guest hash-library dependency or loader override is introduced.
- This README documents the exact frozen reports and future runner boundary.

The builder is source-only until root separately authorizes its execution. Its
CLI requires `--output-dir` (fresh directory under `build/goal39-evidence`),
`--artifact-receipt`, `--artifact-review`, `--source-successor` and
`--source-successor-sha256`. Existing files/symlinks/directories
are rejected, subprocesses are finite and output is bounded. The target is the
actual WOS compiler/sysroot and libc; only the new user fixture is compiled.
No kernel build, VM disk, sysroot mutation or source rebaseline occurs. Keep
failed small receipts/logs and never overwrite evidence to retry.

Before runtime, root must review the actual compiled parent/ELFs/dependencies,
full installed-byte hashes, source preservation, independent launcher and offline
validator. Existing artifact-only success does not prove private startup.

## Guest installation and invocation

Install `/usr/libexec/lifecycle-raw-pilot` and the three frozen artifact files
under `/usr/libexec/lifecycle-raw-artifacts/`, root-owned0555. The hosted parent
links explicitly to `/lib/ld.so`; install the same builder-pinned ordinary loader
there and verify its complete installed hash. The raw Tiny interpreter remains
`/lib/lifecycle-tiny-ld.so` inside its private root. Results are a new
`/srv/lifecycle-raw-pilot-results/`0700 UID/GID100 directory. Actual asset stat
requires regular0555/UID0/GID0 and exact compiled size/bytes, rechecked through
the same open FD after CREATE before close.

Normal entry:

```
/usr/libexec/lifecycle-raw-pilot --pilot NONCE STATIC_COOKIE TINY_COOKIE
```

Each argument is1..16 hexadecimal digits without prefix/sign/whitespace; nonce
is nonzero64bit, cookies are distinct nonzero values<2^60. The host generates
fresh CSPRNG values and pins exact argv/config/source/artifact hashes. O_EXCL
files and nonce/cookie/report equality prevent stale receipt adoption. The
child-writable grant is not cryptographic attestation against arbitrary malicious
programs; this fixture trusts the independently reviewed exact artifact bytes,
root-owned read-only installation and declared three-service environment.

The configured original service is `lifecycle-raw-pilot`; the independent service
is `lifecycle-raw-pilot-witness`, same binary with exactly
`--init-exit-witness`, depends on pilot exit-success. Pilot depends on journald.
Use Host UID/GID100, no supplementary groups, umask0077, authority0, NNPyes,
service-privilegesnone, LOCAL, oneshot/restartnever, environmentempty with the
actual required loader path, `stdio=inherit` and readiness=exit-success. Parent
and witness inherit init's existing console FD0/1/2 so their actual status writes
reach serial. Native private children receive only the explicit report FD9;
console descriptors and console paths are absent from their Spec. Parent checks
actual PID>2/PPID1, identity, groups0, LOCAL flags and all16 resource pairs.
Every other baseline slot0..255 must be -EBADF. All actual F_GETFD/F_GETFL
values are compared after each wave.

Attempt04 used `stdio=journal`: init journaled the two successful status lines
under these service names, which have no default serial output route. The full
qualification correctly failed despite all twelve durable files being present.
The inherited-console wiring changes no parser, status, child grant or timeout;
exactly one corresponding serial PASS for both parent and witness remains
mandatory before the unchanged120-second watchdog.

## Ownership, limits and finite operation

Before CREATE the only extra handles are selected asset(s) and the fresh RW report
File: they must remain open through real input capture. No unrelated metadata,
configuration, verification or receipt FD survives the pre-CREATE allowlist scan.
Destination FD9 receives the same File; child CLOEXEC isfalse by actual native
installation, despite parent descriptors being O_CLOEXEC. File.fd is mutable and
does not define identity; actual ino/dev/size/F_GETFL and positional bytes do.

Each Spec is408/version1, root8MiB, denied network/authority0/service0/dumpable0,
one18-byte `/app/lifecycle-raw` argv and no environment. Static imports main only;
tiny additionally imports `/lib/lifecycle-tiny-ld.so`, both private modes0755.
Child requests CPU-time soft/hard10s only if both captured parent values permit
it; NOFILE min(parent,256)>=10, FSIZE min(parent,1MiB)>=8192, every other pair
inherits exact parent values. No limit increases or service aggregate bypass.
CPU is a time budget, not a cpuset. This pilot observes admitted values, not
CPU-limit exhaustion or all future inheritance behavior.

The immutable raw deadline is10s after checked parent input-start clock. Overall
parent deadline is30s from entry; READY/heartbeat poll until min(CREATEreturn+5s,
childdeadline-2s,overall deadline). Polls sleep1ms via real TIME calls and validate
all clocks/overflow/progression. Raw child performs16 rounds before READY and
round17..10000 after it. Parent accepts two equal complete READY reads, two equal
fresh complete HB reads, kill(pid,0) live authorization, fsync/readback and another
complete HB before closing FD9's parent handle. Kill9 must occur before deadline-1s
and within2s of READY/HB observations. Wait WNOHANG is bounded5s/overall deadline;
only0 and -EINTR retry, and only the exact owned PID/raw9 consumes successfully.

Positive ownership is recorded immediately after CREATE before clock/close/I/O.
Exact consuming wait marks reaped before later I/O and prevents any later signal.
Unexpected wait positive/negative results fail and invalidate further PID-only
signal authority; cleanup cannot risk a reused PID. Other failed waves close all
handles first, kill only their known positive/unreaped child and attempt bounded
exact wait, preserving actual failure outcomes. A finite host watchdog must handle
a stuck syscall; an absolute user clock cannot interrupt kernel blocking.

After consume the parent may reopen its original Host File, verify immutable
input/READY/stat identity, then closes the observer before receipts/baseline/next
wave. A later heartbeat write can be interrupted by SIGKILL: the independently
saved accepted complete heartbeat is liveness evidence, and final mutable bytes
need not contain another complete commit. Every receipt is O_EXCL0600,
PWRITE-exact/fsync/close; close or persistence failure prevents PASS.

## Required future offline runner gates and limits

The launcher/validator are not implemented by these three files. They must bind
the HostReport PID to the exact original init spawn line and independently parse
every raw/Host field,12 files, snapshot/status, actual parent/raw installed hashes,
exact service/nonce/cookies and current complete source/kernel/build proof.
Initial parent PASS or launcher0 cannot substitute for actual init reaping.
Only exact witness PASS may end collection; reject FAIL/failure-context/panic,
duplicates, malformed files, restart, clock violation and source drift. Witness's
own exit and natural VM shutdown are not observed.

Run one isolated Normal8CPU rootless topology with `--no-setup`, preserve KTEST
roots, refuse every output collision before mutations, and pin actual Native71
1426/175/exact3disabled/zeroFAIL/naturalpoweroff/launcher0/stable/pruned proof and
current compile/format/preservation evidence. Validate exact QMP/PID/image
ownership and unrelated VMs before launch; never adopt user VMs. Owned allocated
storage budget20GiB/free floor40GiB; private overlays/reflinks where compatible.
Every outcome must exact-stop, prove offline and prune owned disposable disks/
appliances before overall qualification. Keep small failure logs/hashes/receipts,
never completed full disks.

Raw wait9 follows actual ordinary descriptor and SysV attachment cleanup, but
Task/Thread/deferred pagemap/namespace GC comes later. This fixture therefore
proves no aggregate reference counts, zero-private baseline or debt/census
closure. The later diagnostic controller still needs selected-driver/phase7/
all8-ready gates,24 scoped consumed failures and1,000 full successful scheduled
lifecycles. No whole Goal39, remote/worker exec, hostile, CPU exhaustion,2h,
witness-own-exit or natural poweroff qualification is claimed here.
